Every paid plan starts with 30 days free

The first 30 days are completely free, starting from the day you set up your workspace. No card is taken, and there is no automatic charge — ever. When the trial ends, you choose a plan inside the app and pay yourself; nothing is deducted on its own.

If you choose not to pay, nothing bad happens to your data: the Workspace becomes read-only — you can still see and export everything — and you can move to the free Udhaar plan instead. Pay later, and you continue from exactly where you left off. You can also delete your account and your business data yourself, any time, from Settings — with the small legal exceptions explained in the Privacy Policy.

Business Mart — free

Buying and selling in Business Mart, BizYour's built-in wholesale bazaar, is free for every business — no trial, no end date, no commission charged by BizYour on your deals. Deals in the Mart are contracts between the buyer and the seller; BizYour provides the platform.

Common questions

Do I need a card to start the free trial?

No. No card, no UPI mandate, no payment details of any kind are taken for the trial.

Will I be charged automatically after 30 days?

No. BizYour never charges automatically. After the trial you decide, inside the app, whether to take a monthly or yearly plan — Billing + Stock at ₹129/month or ₹1,299/year, or Everything at ₹169/month or ₹1,699/year (+ 18% GST). You can also drop to the free Udhaar plan instead.

What exactly happens if my trial ends and I don't pay?

Your Workspace turns read-only: all your bills, stock and records stay visible and exportable, nothing is deleted, and Business Mart keeps working for free. You can also switch to the free Udhaar plan — udhaar/khata for up to 25 customers and 100 transactions a month, plus Mart buying — and keep using that free forever. Paying later unlocks writing again in the same account.

Is Business Mart really free, with no catch?

Yes. The Mart is free to use for buying and selling. BizYour does not take a commission on Mart deals; payment and delivery happen directly between buyer and seller.

Can I leave BizYour and take my data?

Yes. Backup and export are built in, and you can delete your account and your business data yourself from Settings → Data. A few records may be kept in anonymised form only where the law requires it or to settle a dispute, as the Privacy Policy explains. Your data is yours; there is no lock-in.
